pages.title: Superconducting Solder
pages.text: Solder that conducts electricity without resistance. Chilled with superfluid helium, it joins femtoscale components with perfect efficiency. It shimmers faintly when current passes through. Magnets float above a puddle of it, pinned in place by expelled field lines.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Femtoscale components needed joints with no resistance. Condensing a Superconducting Coil with superfluid helium, I got a solder that kept its superconductivity even at the joint.
